summary:
Astronaut X is an autonomous, multimodal AI co-pilot developed to assist crew members during long-duration space missions.

In deep-space exploration—such as lunar and Martian expeditions—communication latency with Earth mission control can exceed 20 minutes, making real-time ground guidance impossible during critical equipment or system anomalies. Astronaut X addresses this challenge by operating as an edge-deployed, fully offline intelligence system directly aboard the spacecraft. It continuously ingests multi-sensor telemetry, interprets life-support data, and queries onboard technical flight documentation to deliver instant, step-by-step troubleshooting and procedural checklists.

This project is critical because it removes single-point dependency on ground control, mitigates astronaut cognitive overload under extreme stress, and enables split-second emergency decision-making when communication links are severed, ensuring mission safety and survival.
details:
Astronaut X is a web-based mission control dashboard built with modern JavaScript and Tailwind CSS that aggregates and monitors real-time telemetry across lunar, Martian, and orbital missions.
It transforms complex flight data into interactive 3D visualizations and automated hazard alerts, drastically reducing operator cognitive load and accelerating critical decision-making for deep-space exploration.
